```plato

// A Pade approximant about Center
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pad%C3%A9_approximant): the rational function
// Numerator over Denominator that matches a power series to the highest order
// the two degrees allow. The Denominator's constant term is normalized to 1.
type PadeApproximant
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Number;
    Numerator: Polynomial;
    Denominator: Polynomial;
}
```
